form.label: Fortinet FortiGate/FortiOS Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed onboarding and first-triage view for FortiGate/FortiOS key=value traffic, UTM, and VPN rows. Dashboard presence does not imply replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype=fortinet:fortigate host=$host_filter$ type=traffic | stats count
index=$index$ sourcetype=fortinet:fortigate host=$host_filter$ (type=utm OR threat=* OR virus=*) (action=blocked OR action=block OR action=deny OR threat=* OR virus=*) | stats count
index=$index$ sourcetype=fortinet:fortigate host=$host_filter$ (subtype=vpn OR tunnelid=* OR tunneltype=*) | stats count

index=$index$ sourcetype=fortinet:fortigate host=$host_filter$ | eval fortinet_family=case(type="traffic","traffic", type="utm" OR isnotnull(threat) OR isnotnull(virus),"utm", subtype="vpn" OR isnotnull(tunnelid) OR isnotnull(tunneltype),"vpn", true(),"other") | timechart count by fortinet_family
index=$index$ sourcetype=fortinet:fortigate host=$host_filter$ | eval fortinet_action=coalesce(action,status) | top limit=12 fortinet_action

index=$index$ sourcetype=fortinet:fortigate host=$host_filter$ | stats count values(action) as actions values(transport) as transports values(service) as services values(appcat) as app_categories values(dest_port) as dest_ports by src dest | sort - count | head 25

index=$index$ sourcetype=fortinet:fortigate host=$host_filter$ (type=utm OR threat=* OR virus=*) | table _time host dvc serial type subtype level action src dest dest_port transport service threat virus file signature signature_id marker _raw | sort - _time | head 50

index=$index$ sourcetype=fortinet:fortigate host=$host_filter$ type=traffic | table _time host dvc serial logid sessionid policyid src srcport src dest dstip dest_port dstport transport proto service action signature signature_id sentbyte rcvdbyte marker _raw | sort - _time | head 75

index=$index$ sourcetype=fortinet:fortigate host=$host_filter$ (subtype=vpn OR tunnelid=* OR tunneltype=*) | table _time host dvc serial user remip src action status result tunnelid tunneltype signature signature_id marker _raw | sort - _time | head 50

index=$index$ sourcetype=fortinet:fortigate host=$host_filter$ | eval coverage=coalesce(dvc,devname,"unknown_device") . " / policy=" . coalesce(policyid,"unknown") . " / service=" . coalesce(service,"unknown") | top limit=15 coverage

index=$index$ sourcetype=fortinet:fortigate host=$host_filter$ | stats count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen dc(marker) as fixture_markers values(dvc) as devices values(serial) as serials by index sourcetype source host | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - count

index=$index$ sourcetype=fortinet:fortigate host=$host_filter$ | table _time index sourcetype source host vendor product dvc serial devname devid type subtype level logid eventid action status src srcip remip dest dstip dest_port dstport transport proto service policyid sessionid threat virus tunnelid tunneltype signature signature_id marker msg _raw | sort - _time | head 100

html.p: Scope and evidence boundary: This dashboard is limited to fixture-backed FortiGate/FortiOS key=value traffic, UTM/threat, and VPN tunnel smoke rows. It does not prove full FortiOS log-family coverage, Fortinet TA parity, firmware-specific field completeness, collector health, exact timezone validation, or SC4S/Splunk replay/read-back validation.
